data.name: Devishay
data.gender_notes: Devishay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Devishay is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Deva' meaning god and 'Ishaya' meaning abode or home. This name symbolizes the divine dwelling place of the gods, and is often used as a reminder of the spiritual connection between the individual and the divine. The name Devishay carries the meaning “God's Abode” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devishay usually hope their child will grow to embody god's abode and live with faith, good character and purpose.
